summary: Frontend-only verification of MockReel hook + end-card overlays. All 12 requirement checks pass. Uploaded 6s and 2s WebM clips, tested in Hand-Holding + Floating views, verified punch-in animation, safe-area respect (right icon rail + bottom caption strip clean), all hook/cta data-testid controls, four accent swatches, and short-clip 45%-window guard. Rendered output is baked into the canvas so MediaRecorder export path unchanged from previous passing iterations.

critical_code_review_comments: App.tsx is now ~1400 lines — consider splitting Sidebar controls, drawPhone/drawOverlays/drawFloatingScene, and the export logic into separate modules for maintainability.

In drawEndCard, timeLeft can be negative if video played past duration (loop) — the early return handles it, but a small guard on video.currentTime > duration would avoid the transient overlap during the loop wrap frame.

Overlay accent state (overlayAccent) is shared by hook underline and cta — the request only mentions changing accent from the CTA panel. Docs note is fine, but hook underline color also flips silently. Consider surfacing that visually or splitting into two accents.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Pixel-region sampling of overlays is unreliable during the punch-in animation (alpha < 1 on dark pills makes white pixels come out ~226, below the >230 threshold). Use screenshots or lower the whiteness threshold (>=200) to detect punch-in mid-animation. Video preview element is document.querySelector('video'); pause+seek pattern works for deterministic overlay timing.
